title: Fairness Evaluation for Diffusion and Flow Models Should Account for the Generation Path: Implications for Clinical Imaging
abstract: arXiv:2611.28077v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Medical image generation models are often evaluated using images produced by a single sampling procedure. However, diffusion and flow models can use different numbers of sampling steps, sampling schedules, or numerical solvers without changing their trained parameters. These changes may affect the generated images and the clinical measurements derived from them. We argue that fairness results obtained under one sampling procedure should not be assumed to hold under another, particularly when changes in sampling affect clinical task errors differently across patient groups. Building on previous work on medical image quality, accelerated sampling, generation dynamics, and generative model fairness, we examine why the sampling procedure should be considered part of the evaluated system. translated_title: 扩散模型与流模型的公平性评估应考虑生成路径：对临床成像的启示
translated_abstract: 医学图像生成模型通常仅使用由单一采样过程生成的图像进行评估。然而，扩散模型和流模型可以在不改变已训练参数的情况下，采用不同数量的采样步数、采样时间表或数值求解器。这些变化可能会影响生成的图像以及由其导出的临床测量结果。我们主张，在一种采样过程下获得的公平性结果不应被假定在另一种采样过程下同样成立，尤其是当采样方式的变化对不同患者群体的临床任务误差产生不同影响时。基于先前关于医学图像质量、加速采样、生成动力学和生成模型公平性的研究，我们探讨了为什么采样过程应被视为被评估系统的一部分。我们定义了跨采样过程的临床任务误差的亚组差异，并给出一个数学示例，表明两个群体可以具有相同的（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 本文提出扩散模型与流模型的公平性评估必须将采样过程（包括采样步数、采样调度和数值求解器）视为被评估系统的一部分，因为不同采样配置会在不同患者群体间产生不同的临床任务误差。
en_tdlr: This paper argues that fairness evaluation for diffusion and flow models should treat the sampling procedure as part of the evaluated system, since different sampling configurations can produce different clinical task errors across patient groups.
